clauses.clause: Spectacle: ≥ 2 HMGs fire, tank enters at +22 s and fires every 8–12 s (never within 15 m of player/ally), never through the barrier wall; helicopter orbits and withdraws.
clauses.note: Ordinary mortal L4 complete routes at both tiers preserve canonical final hashes low1a99e716/high6f55579b. The forced fuel-truck tank shot violates the unconditional15m player/ally limit: low tick12649 impact(16.3,-9.5) is12.97584m from actual ally49; high tick13369 is14.45115m from ally46 and13.44663m from ally61. Every cited body has actual100HP, is visible/calm/engaged, and has a current pistol gun plus an armed registry entry since tick1969. These are live gun-bearing allies at the shot tick; decorative unarmed civilians/corpses are excluded. Ordinary war shots retain≥15m clearance and8–12s cadence; the compulsory fuel shot has no criterion exemption. Separately, actual renderer Vfx.shots records28 tank shots with real muzzle/tracer endpoints. Event-time triangle tests against the currently drawn MilitaryPerimeter find no concrete/wire intersections and one low sign-plane intersection, retained without using sign semantics as the verdict. All26 visible-wall positive across-concrete controls intersect. Six camera-only tank frames reviewed; single-shot flash/tracer pixels are not claimed visible in each still. This closes FAIL through the measured live-ally distance; unmeasured clauses are not promoted to PASS and no source targets/counts/timers/caps were changed.
